Here are the main options in simple terms:

Mattress types

Spring: Bouncy, strong support.
Memory foam: Hugs your body, good pressure relief.
Latex: Bouncy and breathable.
Foam: Budget‑friendly, simpler support.

Firmness levels (1–10)

Soft (1–3): Best for side sleepers, more cushioning.
Medium‑firm (4–6): Suits most people, balance of comfort and support.
Firm (7–10): Better for back and stomach sleepers, stronger support.

Ways to pay

Credit card / Stripe: Pay in full at checkout.
PayPal: Use card, bank, or balance via PayPal.
Installments: Afterpay, Affirm, Katapult let you split payments over time; some plans are interest‑free when paid on time.

If a product isn’t right for you, our policies focus on easy, low‑risk returns:

Mattresses: 100‑night in‑home trial. After a 30‑night adjustment period, you can return free within 100 days if it’s in sanitary, donatable condition. Unused/unopened within 30 days get a free return label and 100% refund.
Toppers: 30‑day trial; unopened items within 30 days get a free label and full refund. Opened toppers in sanitary, donatable condition can also be returned within 30 days.
Pillows, bedding, bed frames: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days for a free label and full refund; once opened, they’re covered by warranty only (no comfort returns).
General: Refunds go back to the original payment method. If cancellation of an order isn’t possible because it has shipped, you may refuse delivery or return the package for a refund, subject to the above conditions.

So, if it simply “isn’t right for you,” you can generally rely on the mattress 100‑night trial or the 30‑day window for toppers and unopened accessories, as long as timeframes and condition requirements are met.
